general_information.name: UM—SORRY, DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY ID? I ALWAYS GET THIS BIT MIXED UP. IT’S ETHAN, AND THE LAST NAME IS PARK, I THINK… OR, WELL, THAT’S HOW I USUALLY SAY IT.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly this… I get really stuck when I have to speak in meetings or if there’s a group thing at work, and then I sort of go red and shake, which is embarrassing, and I start avoiding the socials too. I even turned down a promotion because it meant presenting, so that was… not great.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to speak up in a meeting without panicking, basically. And, um, I’d like to take the next promotion if it comes up instead of dodging it.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and as a kid I was pretty quiet, sort of watchful, I guess. I didn’t really put myself forward much.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School was mostly fine — I was a good student — but presentations were always a problem, so I avoided them the whole way through. That kind of carried on later too, honestly.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m single. The only relationships I really have are two close friends from university, but I don’t know if that’s what you mean.
personal_history.future_goals: Mostly I want to build a career that doesn’t depend on avoiding people. And, well, I’d like to get better at handling that speaking-up-in-meetings thing too.
